name: Mitsubishi Cn105 → Vane Control
description: The `mitsubishi_cn105.vane.control` action changes the vane direction. Its `id` must reference the top-level Mitsubishi CN105 hub. The currently supported setting is `vertical.direction`, which accepts `AUTO`, `1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, `5`, or `SWING`. It can also be a lambda returning one of the corresponding `VERTICAL_VANE_MODE_*` values. A lambda returning `VERTICAL_VANE_MODE_UNKNOWN` is ignored and does not change the vane direction.

config_entries.label: ID
